common42_definition.preferred_short_definition: One frozen COMMON-42 V4 rule-descriptor portfolio representing the 42 executable relation projections shared by T0, T1, and T1-B, rebound to the audited normal-only runtime numeric authority.
common42_definition.why_common: Every one of the 42 executable-equivalence records has common_arm_cells exactly T0, T1, and T1-B. The protocol treats identical executable projections as one runtime library rather than three independent predictions.

object_layers.meaning: The frozen normal delayed-response relation identities and semantics.
One arm-independent executable signature per relation plus proof that T0, T1, and T1-B have identical projections.
Relation identity, binding hash, semantic-execution hash, direction, horizon, and reference identities; no private numeric values.

object_layers.meaning: The V4-specific canonical runtime descriptors consumed by D1. This is not demonstrated here to be a tuple of paperworks.contracts.RuleV1 objects.

arm_to_portfolio_mapping.common42_member_source: Identical per-relation executable projection shared with T1 and T1-B.
arm_to_portfolio_mapping.qualification: D1 uses the deduplicated COMMON-42 projection, not a separately retained T0 runtime library.

arm_to_portfolio_mapping.common42_member_source: Identical per-relation executable projection shared with T0 and T1-B.
arm_to_portfolio_mapping.qualification: The LLM proposal provenance is explicitly excluded from the executable signature; D1 does not load a distinct T1 library.

arm_to_portfolio_mapping.common42_member_source: Identical per-relation executable projection shared with T0 and T1.
arm_to_portfolio_mapping.qualification: D1 does not treat repeated equivalent T1-B proposals as separate predictions.
All 39 accepted T2 projections match their COMMON counterparts, but exact T2 membership is not public and T2 utility scope is explicitly unauthorized.

why_39_and_42_coexist.explanation: COMMON-42 is the 42-relation executable portfolio proven common to T0, T1, and T1-B. T2 is a separate construction arm with 39 accepted equivalent projections and 3 no_rule cells. V4 explicitly excludes T2 from utility authority, so the D1 portfolio remains 42 while T2 remains a descriptive 39/3 construction result.
why_39_and_42_coexist.scientific_interpretation: The 39/42 T2 result is neither the COMMON-42 portfolio cardinality nor a D1 rule count.

verifier_dependency.proved_dependency: COMMON-42 depends on the frozen executable-equivalence audit and V4 canonical authority replay/validation.
verifier_dependency.qualification: The runtime object is CanonicalRuleDescriptorV4 under UtilityProtocolV4CanonicalAuthority. Calling this direct canonical RuleV1 materialization or canonical VerifierV1 acceptance would overstate the audited lineage.

numeric_authority_dependency.binding: Each CanonicalRuleDescriptorV4 binds its relation and semantic hashes, 10 new reference identities, and the numeric-authority descriptor hash.
numeric_authority_dependency.rebind: V4 builds new relation-role reference identities from COMMON semantics and binds them to the independently materialized normal-only authority; historical numeric identity substitution and T2 authority are prohibited.

freeze_and_hash_lineage.modification_detection: Canonical builders replay exact object types, relation ordering, cardinality, semantic preimages, reference sets, descriptor hashes, full-census plan, and authority hash; mismatches fail closed.
freeze_and_hash_lineage.unknown: There is no separately observed committed file containing 42 paperworks.contracts.RuleV1 instances; the frozen runtime authority is reconstructible V4 metadata plus private numeric resolver custody.

d1_consumer.authority_replay: _load_public_authorities_v1 reconstructs UtilityProtocolV4CanonicalAuthority from executable equivalence, E1 manifest, dataset/schema configs, and materialized numeric-authority receipt.
d1_consumer.enumeration: All automatically enumerated applicable opportunities over exactly 42 V4 descriptors.

agentic_rule_only.reason: T2 is excluded from COMMON-42 utility authority and D1; the frozen T2 cohort has only 39 accepted relations and no feedback actions.

llm_rule_only.reason: T1 and T1-B proposals contributed equivalent construction projections, but the D1 runtime loads one arm-deduplicated V4 portfolio whose provenance-specific provider fields were intentionally excluded. It is not a distinct LLM-produced runtime library.

verified_relational_rule_only.reason: It accurately describes the frozen relation and executable-authority checks, provided verified is explicitly limited to contract, provenance, and integrity checks rather than scientific truth or utility.

canonical_rule_portfolio.reason: V4 calls its 42 objects CanonicalRuleDescriptorV4; this must not be silently equated with paperworks.contracts.RuleV1 canonical materialization.

professor_facing_implication.short_answer_ko: 현재 D1은 T2가 만든 42개의 Agentic 규칙을 평가한 것이 아닙니다. T0, T1, T1-B에서 실행 의미가 동일하다고 확인된 42개 관계를 하나의 COMMON-42 V4 규칙 설명자 포트폴리오로 중복 제거하고, 정상 데이터 기반 수치 권한에 다시 결속하여 실행한 Rule-only 평가입니다. 따라서 현재 결과는 COMMON-42 Verified Relational Rule-only로 부르는 것이 가장 정확합니다.
professor_facing_implication.future_required_for_true_t2_llm_specific: Freeze exact T2 membership and its runtime authority as a separately preregistered portfolio, preserve its three no_rule cells, authorize it explicitly, and evaluate it independently without reusing the current COMMON-42 result.

findings.finding: COMMON-42 is V4-specific descriptor authority, not proven direct canonical RuleV1 materialization.
findings.impact: Documentation that equates V4 descriptors with canonical RuleV1 or canonical VerifierV1 acceptance overstates the lineage.

findings.finding: D1 is not a T2/Agentic runtime portfolio.
findings.impact: Calling the frozen D1 result Agentic Rule-only would attach an unexecuted construction arm to the result.

findings.finding: LLM Rule-only is an ambiguous label for D1.
findings.impact: It obscures that the runtime portfolio is the deduplicated common executable projection and that provider provenance fields are excluded.

findings.finding: The original V4 protocol-freeze hash is historical after focused R1 authority hardening.
findings.impact: Current D1 lineage must cite the current R1 V4 authority hash rather than only the historical V4 hash.

unknowns: The public equivalence artifact does not reveal exact T2 accepted/no_rule relation membership.
This Agent C audit does not prove proposal-to-paperworks.contracts.RuleV1 projection or canonical VerifierV1 acceptance; those are separate ARCH-005 equivalence/verifier questions.
